text: Quinn O'Brien is a Data Scientist at CyberSentinel Technologies, where he applies machine learning to enhance cybersecurity defenses. With two years of experience, he focuses on turning raw data into actionable insights that protect critical infrastructure. His work involves building scalable models using Python, leveraging Pandas for data manipulation, and NumPy for efficient numerical computations. Quinn specializes in automating threat detection workflows, integrating real-time data streams into predictive analytics frameworks. He collaborates closely with security teams to refine models that adapt to evolving threats. Outside of work, he enjoys exploring how data science can address complex challenges in both tech and everyday contexts. Quinn is driven by solving real-world problems through intelligent, data-driven solutions.
